selection.resolved_dominance: point Pareto dominance and all paired-delete-block lower limits >= 0; at least one > 0
selection.unresolved_parent_comparison: uniform between two sampled valid canonical candidates
selection.retention: all candidates not resolved-dominated; archive size remains a soft target
selection.scales: reference mean deficits: 1-PR-AUC, Brier, spending RMSE
selection.meaning: operational uncertainty-averse search heuristic, not simultaneous coverage or a superiority test

execution_backend: local serial numerical worker; no implied remote GitHub dispatch
final_test_interface: not enabled; independent protocol lock and reporting required
spending_pooling: unchanged mean of equal-sized batch means
